pull.body:
Adds a Romberg entry to RULES in report/figures/make_figures.py: diamond marker (D), colour #CC79A7, legend label 'Romberg (extrapolated trapezoid)'. Also refreshes report/figures/data/{errors,fits,reference}.csv to experiment-repo 19ef54b (four-rule sweep, job-75f8449da6) and updates the series-count check from 6 to 8; provenance SHA/job updated. Data/fit checks all PASS.

Known issue for you to resolve when regenerating (layout is yours): with four series the script's overlap check FAILS. exp(-x^2): the trapezoid order label collides with the legend (legend_loc upper right); x^(1/3): order labels 1.3246/1.3333/1.3465 collide at n=1024 (needs vertical label nudging). I did not touch layout. PNGs are not regenerated in this PR; please regenerate after merge.
